_comment: Vendor driver packages the agent may download on first use. Never bundled (invariant 7).
match: regexes on the printer's make / model / 1284 device-id. packages: URL + sha256 of a .deb,
or of an archive with `members` (glob per architecture) naming the .deb files inside it.
arch: architecture of the binaries when the package itself is a .deb. arm64 runs natively, amd64 through FEX (qemu-x86_64 where FEX cannot run), i386 through qemu-i386.
amd64 through Rosetta, i386 cannot run (Rosetta is x86-64 only) -- listed for the record.
Sources: vendor download pages and the AUR PKGBUILDs that wrap them; sha256 verified by download.

drivers.title: Canon UFR II / UFRII LT printer driver 6.30 (cnrdrvcups-ufr2-uk)
drivers.note: Canon ships a native arm64 build, which is what gets installed and what was verified (a page renders in about a second). The x86-64 build in the same archive spins without producing output under every interpreter tried; do not select it by hand.

drivers.title: Canon CAPT printer driver 2.71 (cndrvcups-capt + cndrvcups-common), x86-64 under FEX
drivers.note: Experimental, and doubly so: CAPT expects its ccpd daemon's bidirectional link (through the lpbridge USB relay the stream is pushed one-way), and Canon's x86-64 UFR II module was observed spinning without output under Rosetta, qemu and FEX alike in this guest -- the CAPT module may behave the same. Not hardware-verified.

drivers.title: Brother MFC-9340CDW LPR driver 1.1.2 + CUPS wrapper 1.1.4 (i386, qemu)
drivers.note: Brother's own GDI driver. The printer also speaks BR-Script/PCL and IPP Everywhere, so this is one candidate among several.

drivers.title: Brother HL-3040CN LPR driver 1.1.2 + CUPS wrapper 1.1.2 (i386, qemu)
drivers.note: GDI-only colour laser: this driver is the only way to print to it.
